user.description: Address of your ring. This can by found a few different ways, but the easiest are visiting (your home assistant URL)/config/bluetooth/advertisement-monitor and finding something with a Name like R02_XXXX (for an R02 ring) OR using Gadgetbridge on Android.

error.connection: Unable to connect to the server.

init.description: Heart rate freshness, BLE polling, history backfill, and gesture detection options.

data.hr_stale_after_polls: Grace polls before Heart Rate goes unknown after the ring is removed (0 = fastest detection)
data.poll_max_interval: Maximum BLE polling interval in minutes (the integration polls at your heart-rate sampling period, up to this limit)
data.hr_backfill: Log heart-rate samples recorded while out of Bluetooth range into history
data.steps_backfill: Experimental: also backfill steps/distance/calories history (raw graph only, may not show in long-term statistics)
data.motion_enabled: Enable gesture detection (adds a Motion Stream switch and clap/hand-raise/hand-lower events; streaming pauses normal polling and uses more battery)
data.motion_stream_timeout: Turn the motion stream off automatically after this many minutes (0 = leave it on until switched off)
data.motion_log_samples: Log every accelerometer sample to the debug log (for tuning gestures)
